# Bluey

Bluey is a private desktop AI copilot for engineering meetings and live technical work.

## Product Summary

Bluey helps users ask questions from the context already around their work:
live conversation, transcripts, screen context, attached files, documents,
code, saved session memory, and project notes. Bluey is terminal-first: install
it, run `bluey on`, and use the desktop overlay when live context is needed.

Bluey is not positioned as a meeting recorder or generic chatbot. The intended
use case is source-aware help during technical work: design reviews, planning,
incident calls, implementation discussions, customer debugging, demos, research,
and document-heavy work sessions.

## Core Capabilities

- Desktop overlay for asking from current work context.
- Live transcript context from user-controlled listening.
- Screen context analysis triggered by visible controls.
- File and document attachment for answer grounding.
- Saved session memory and searchable project context.
- Managed AI routing for quick, coding, screen, research, and deep answers.
- Status events that show when Bluey is reading screen context, attached docs,
  saved memory, or managed web sources.
- Credits model: start free, then add account credits for paid AI models,
  speech transcription, screen analysis, and saved-session search.

## Trust And Safety

- Bluey should be used only for work context the user is authorized to capture,
  upload, or analyze.
- Capture and listening are tied to visible user controls.
- Provider API keys for managed cloud requests stay server-side.
- Account-scoped saved sessions support export and deletion workflows.
- Bluey should not be described as a way to bypass rules, proctoring, security
  controls, or consent requirements.

## Suggested Short Description

Bluey is a private desktop copilot that listens to live work, reads approved
context, and answers from your meeting, screen, files, code, docs, and project
memory.

## Suggested Category

AI productivity, engineering meeting assistant, desktop AI copilot, live
context assistant.
